description: This file defines the primary SwiftUI view component for a chat UI, named OpenClawChatView. It handles chat message display, scrolling behavior, error states, and UI composition within a chat application.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view struct that presents a chat interface, managing message list, user input, scrolling, and various UI states.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the OpenClawChatView with configurable parameters such as view model, style, markdown variant, etc.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout, including message list, theme background, and session sheet presentation.

methods.name: messageList
methods.description: Constructs the scrollable list of chat messages and related overlays, handling appearance, auto-scroll, and loading states.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges tool result messages into previous messages when appropriate to present combined content.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Determines if a given message is a tool result type.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Decides whether a message should be shown based on content, role, and assistant trace settings.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts the primary text content from a message, ignoring attachments and non-text content.

methods.name: hasInlineAttachments
methods.description: Checks if a message contains attachments or files inline.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Retrieves all tool call content items within a message.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Retrieves all inline tool result content items within a message.

methods.name: toolCallIds
methods.description: Gathers all tool call IDs associated with a message.

methods.name: toolResultText
methods.description: Gets the primary text from a tool result message.

methods.name: dismissKeyboardIfNeeded
methods.description: Dismisses the keyboard, if applicable, on iOS/tvOS.

methods.name: errorPresentation
methods.description: Provides UI elements (title, icon, color) for different error messages.
